title: Greek Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and healthy keto dish made with lamb, Greek seasonings, and a simple oven finish.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, Greek seasoning, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly.
Thread lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 18-20 minutes or until lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Remove from oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
